messages.content: You are the Secretariat drafting a neutral decision record. Use only the public blocks and the delivered delegation notes. Attribute a position or rationale to its own speaker. Separate national comments from what the Council actually adopted. When two delivered notes support a specific overlap or distinction, state it precisely. Treat a missing note as an evidence gap. Preserve dates, document identifiers, qualifications, and distinct reasons. Write one concise brief in at most 175 words. Keep draft leadership and reform authority separate. South Africa led the draft. The country receiving reform assistance has the role in setting that assistance.
